name: CLIAMP
author: Brian Scott
description: Now-playing display and playback controls for the CLIAMP terminal music player, with Spotify and YouTube support and a beat-reactive synthwave Party Mode for the bar

barWidget.description: See what cliamp is playing and control playback from the bar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll cliamp for playback status.

schema.label: Max label width (px)
schema.description: Width of the now-playing label before it scrolls.

schema.label: Hide when cliamp is not running
schema.description: Remove the widget from the bar entirely while no cliamp instance is reachable.

schema.label: Party Mode intensity (%)
schema.description: Strength of the synthwave wash painted over the bar in Party Mode.

schema.label: Party Mode style: spectrum bars
schema.description: On shows a cliamp-style spectrum analyser across the bar; off shows the scrolling synthwave gradient wash.

schema.label: Party Mode reacts to the beat
schema.description: Drive the effect from CLIAMP's real audio bands. When off, a calm animated wave is used instead.
